title.zh: CFTC Proposes Explicit Swap Status for Event Contracts
title.en: CFTC Proposes Explicit Swap Status for Event Contracts

current_state.zh: The CFTC proposed classifying event contracts as swaps while preserving existing exchange and trader duties, and issued a separate rule to exclude qualifying casino-style wagers.
